info.name: TMaps API
info.description:
Maps, geocoding and routing APIs with worldwide coverage and extra detail for Tunisia.

## Get started
1. Create an API key in the [TMaps console](https://app.tmaps.tn).
2. Import the **TMaps** environment, set `api_key` and select the environment.
3. Run **Geocoding → Forward geocoding**: it saves the result's coordinates for the other requests.

## Authentication
Every request sends the key in the `api_key` query parameter. It is set once on the collection (Authorization tab) and inherited by all requests. TMaps does not use an `Authorization` header.

Postman calls the API from a server context (no `Origin` header), so the key's authorized domains don't apply here. For backend use, create a dedicated key with no authorized domain: it works from your servers and is rejected in browsers if it ever leaks.

## Conventions
- JSON responses, UTF-8. Coordinates in WGS84 decimal degrees (`lat`, `lng`). Distances in meters, durations in seconds.
- Errors return `{"error": "..."}` with standard HTTP codes: 400 bad parameter, 401 missing or revoked key, 403 domain not authorized, 404 not found, 429 burst protection, 5xx server error.

## Links
- Documentation: https://www.tmaps.tn/documentation
- Live examples: https://examples.tmaps.tn/
- Source: https://github.com/tmaps-tn/tmaps-snippets

`https://tiles.tmaps.tn/r-tile/{z}/{x}/{y}?api_key=YOUR_API_KEY`

Change the `style` collection variable to `streets`, `dark`, `terrain` or `sunny`.

Docs: https://www.tmaps.tn/documentation/api/vector-tiles · Live example: https://examples.tmaps.tn/03-vector-maplibre-styles/

item.name: Geocoding
item.description: Addresses to coordinates, coordinates to addresses, and places around a point.

query.description: Required. Free text: address, street, place or commune.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default: TN.
Maximum number of results, 1 to 20. Default: 5.
Language of labels: fr, en or ar. Default: fr.
lat,lng to favour results near a point (e.g. the user's position).
minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat to restrict the search to an area.
Filter by type: address, street, poi, locality.

request.description:
Turns a free-text address into GPS coordinates, with a confidence score and the Tunisian administrative breakdown (commune, delegation, governorate).

Each result gives the point in `geometry.location` (`lat`, `lng`), a `formatted` address, a `confidence` between 0 and 1 and `components`.

The test script saves the first result's coordinates in the `lat` and `lng` collection variables, so you can run **Reverse geocoding** and **Nearby search** right after.

Docs: https://www.tmaps.tn/documentation/api/geocoding/forward · Live example: https://examples.tmaps.tn/04-geocoding-search/

request.description:
Turns GPS coordinates into the nearest postal address and its commune, delegation and governorate.

The API snaps to the nearest relevant street, building or place: `distance` is the gap in meters between your point and the result. A `404` means no address was found nearby.

Uses the `lat` / `lng` collection variables (Tunis center by default, or the last **Forward geocoding** result).

Docs: https://www.tmaps.tn/documentation/api/geocoding/reverse · Live example: https://examples.tmaps.tn/05-reverse-geocoding/
